text: Sorry to trouble you at this hour, I know you must be busy with more serious things. I'm looking after my granddaughter tonight, she's 10, and she's running a temperature of 38.3. Her eczema has flared up too, dry itchy patches on her arms and behind her knees and she keeps scratching. Her breathing is perfectly normal, I've been watching it, nothing odd there at all. I just don't want to get it wrong while her mum's away. Apologies again for bothering you.
